title: Phantom Wings Elytra
description: This adds a custom new elytra item that allows you to glide when equiped, and not anger phantoms.
body:
JubeTweaks Phantom Wings!!

This mod adds a custom new wings item that when equipped you are able to glide but not use firework rockets. (For balance purposes) PLUS!! Phantoms do not attack you when wearing the wings

To craft a phantom wing it takes 5 Phantom Membranes and to craft the phantom wings it takes two Phantom Wings (See gallery)
